branch_deletion_reason: The connected GitHub tool can merge/repoint refs but does not expose branch-ref deletion. Branch refs are hygiene-only after exact ancestor verification.
safe_cleanup_rule: Delete a non-main branch ref only when its exact head SHA is verified as an ancestor of the current main head. Preserve tags and immutable package artifacts.
note: Safe-delete membership must be regenerated after the final governance merge because any newly created governance branch must itself become an ancestor of main before deletion.
